products.name: Surfer SEO
products.note: SEO optimization AI; content scoring; NLP analysis; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Surfer operates surferseo.com and describes itself as an AI visibility platform built for marketing and SEO teams. Its stated focus is helping brands track and improve their presence across Google and AI-powered search engines including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. The company positions its approach around analyzing content structure, depth, and credibility as the signals that influence how large language models cite sources, rather than traditional keyword density.

The company's primary product, Surfer SEO, combines content writing and editing tools with real-time SEO scoring, NLP analysis, and AI search optimization guidelines, and is available with EU-hosted options. Additional features described on the site include competitor analysis, topical authority planning, programmatic page generation, and continuous monitoring that alerts users when a page loses visibility or a competitor is cited in an AI-generated answer in its place. The site also lists free utilities such as an AI writing tool, an AI detector, and an AI humanizer alongside a Chrome extension.

One user quoted on the site reports more than doubling blog content production while decreasing the cost to produce SEO content by more than four times, described as double the content at a quarter of the price. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
